observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation 4 console with two controllers on top: one silver and one camouflage-patterned.
The console has 'SONY' and 'PS4' branding visible on the front.
The controllers appear to be DualShock 4 models, with the camouflage one having a custom design.
Photo 1 is a similar angle, showing the same console and controllers from a slightly different perspective.
The console is placed on a wooden surface with artificial grass visible in the background.
No games, cables, or other accessories are visible in either photo.
The seller claims the console is 'hacked with fc26 and 10 other interesting games' and includes 'one original pad'.

claims.claim: PlayStation 4 pro hacked with fc26 and 10 other interesting games
claims.evidence: No screen or interface is shown to confirm the hack or installed games. The console's software cannot be verified remotely.
Only two controllers are shown in the photos. The seller claims one is 'original', but no proof of authenticity or model is visible.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional or may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting into the system, and running a game.

risks.risk: Hacked console may be unstable or have performance issues
risks.proof: A video demonstrating the console running a game and responding to inputs without lag or crashes.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-original or counterfeit
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the controller labels or serial numbers, or a video showing the controllers connecting to the console.

risks.risk: Games may not be installed or may be pirated
risks.proof: A screenshot or video showing the installed games list in the console's library.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and running a game.
Close-up photos of the controller labels or serial numbers.
Screenshot or video of the installed games list.
Proof of the 'hacked' status (e.g., a video showing the console booting into a custom firmware or modded interface).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
